rules.description: [winkeys] Shift+Enter => newline in terminals / Electron editors (Claude Code, zsh, REPLs)
[winkeys] Ctrl+Y (QWERTZ 'Y' key) => Cmd+Shift+Z  (Redo) — GUI apps only
[winkeys] F5 / Ctrl+F5 => reload / hard-reload
[winkeys] F12 => Cmd+Opt+I (DevTools)  — browsers only
[winkeys] Ctrl+H => Cmd+Y (history)  — browsers only  [QWERTZ: 'z' keycode == physical Y]
[winkeys] Zoom: Ctrl + keypad -/+/0 => Cmd zoom out / in / reset  (browser)
[winkeys] PC-style Ctrl: left_control+<key> => left_command+<key> (all GUI apps; excluded in terminals, RDP & VM clients)
[winkeys] Ctrl+Home / Ctrl+End => document start / end  (+Shift extends selection)
[winkeys] Home / End => line start / end  (+Shift extends selection)
[winkeys] Ctrl+Left / Ctrl+Right => word jump  (+Shift extends selection)
[winkeys] Ctrl+Backspace / Ctrl+Delete => delete word left / right
[winkeys] Terminals: Ctrl+Left/Right => Option+Left/Right (word motion; also stops the Spaces shortcut)
[winkeys] Ctrl+left-click => Cmd+left-click  (discontiguous multi-select)
[winkeys] Ctrl+Shift+C/V/F/A => Cmd+C/V/F/A ; Ctrl+T/N (and +Shift) => Cmd+T/N  (terminals only; Ctrl+C stays SIGINT)
[winkeys] Ctrl+Insert / Shift+Insert => copy / paste  (terminals only)
[winkeys] Alt+F4 => Cmd+W  (close focused window)  [Alt == left_command; Cmd+Q would quit whole app]
[winkeys] Ctrl+Space => Cmd+Space (Spotlight) — works with a terminal focused too
[winkeys] Finder: F2 => Return (rename)
[winkeys] Finder: Enter => Cmd+O (open selected item)
Option+. => Emojis
Option + V => triggers Native macOS Tahoe Clipboard History
Option + Shift + s => Cmd + Ctrl + Shift + 4 (Screenshot (selectable area) without saving to desk)
Mouse side-keys for browsers and system (forward/back)
Cmd + Opt + L => Cmd + Ctrl + L (format document in IDEs)
option+L => Logout (CGSession -suspend)
Ctrl+Esc => Open Launchpad
Ctrl+Command+Delete => Open Activity Monitor
Option+E Opens Finder
